Check yourself. 1. Why does position size matter more on-chain? The answer: Gas is a roughly fixed cost per action, so it's a bigger percentage of a small position.
Check yourself. 2. When is an LP the only option? The answer: When the pair trades only on-chain.
Check yourself. 3. Market just broke out on huge news. Grid or LP? The answer: Neither, until a new range forms.
